subject: Competitive bake-off recap — Acme Health next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Recap + next steps from today's demo / bake-off kickoff

Hi Jordan / Sara —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call so everyone is aligned and we have clear next steps for the competitive bake-off.

Pain points you confirmed:
- High per-token inference costs on current provider when doing high-throughput clinical summarization.
- Erratic latency during peak business hours affecting patient-facing features.
- Need for stronger observability and audit logs for compliance.

Goals we heard:
1) Reduce per-token cost by at least 30% while maintaining output quality for clinical notes.
2) Hit P95 latency under 350ms for summary endpoints at production load.
3) Ensure auditability (request/response logging + retention controls) for audits.

Decision criteria you shared:
- Clinical-quality hallucination rate (we'll use your evaluation set)
- Cost/unit under target threshold
- Latency under SLO at 95th percentile
- Security/compliance: KMS support + SOC2 evidence

Open questions we committed to answer: 
- Exact quantization profile we'd recommend for your model family (Vivek will propose)
- How our prefix/KV caching will interact with your request patterns (we'll run a short load test)
- Audit/log retention configuration options and sample export (security pack)

Proposed bake-off tests (timeline attached):
1) Controlled quality test using your eval set (we'll run on the candidate Open models + Redwood-verified variants).
2) 48-hour throughput run at expected peak QPS to measure latency and tail behavior.
3) Cost extrapolation based on traced token distribution.

Next steps (owners):
- Vivek: share recommended quantization + runbook for the 48-hour test (by Fri 27 Feb).
- Rishi: schedule a slot for the 48-hour run and share the test harness details and required creds (by Mon 2 Mar).
- Jordan/Sara: confirm which model variants (open vs. base) you want us to include and share the evaluation set link.

Attachments: acme_redwood_comparison_table.xlsx (high-level feature/metric map).

I'll follow up with the exact test schedule and access notes once Rishi confirms availability.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0142

Subject: Re: Recap + next steps from today's demo / bake-off kickoff

Hi Marissa —

Appreciate the clear summary — that matches our notes. A couple clarifications from our side:

1) Model variants: please include the following in the bake-off: our tuned OpenClinical-7B baseline, OpenClinical-13B, and Redwood-quant-7B (if you have it). We want to compare cost/quality tradeoffs.
2) Eval set: Sara will share a secured Drive link with the 150-record evaluation set and ground-truth summaries by EOD. (Sara: ping when uploaded.)
3) Compliance: we need to see a sample audit export (anonymized) and SOC2 evidence — if you can send the SOC2 snapshot and a sample request/response export format that would be great.

On timeline: the window you propose looks good. We can give you a 48-hour run window starting Wed 4 Mar 10:00 PT — would that work?

We'll also want a short smoke test on Mon 2 Mar to validate access and the harness.

Thanks,
Jordan
VP, Product — Acme Health

Subject: Bake-off instructions and acceptance criteria (Acme Health)

Hi Jordan / Sara —

Per the schedule, attached are the detailed bake-off instructions and the acceptance criteria we'll use to evaluate each vendor variant. High level:

1) Quality test (evaluation set): we'll compute ROUGE and a clinician-validated hallucination checklist. Passing threshold: clinician acceptability >= 90% on sampled subset.
2) Performance test (48-hour run): P95 latency < 350ms at measured QPS; no >1% errors.
3) Cost projection: we'll provide per-1M-token extrapolation based on observed throughput and caching effects.

Attachments: redwood_bakeoff_instructions.pdf (includes exact CLI commands, env vars, and how to fetch logs). Also including the comparison spreadsheet for your internal scorecard.

Please confirm you received the Drive link and the attachments. We'll be standing by for the Monday smoke test at 14:00 PT.

If anything changes on your side for the window, flag it early.

Best,
Marissa
